grammar_tips.title: Using Modals for Advice
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'should', 'ought to', or 'must' to give advice. Example: You should set boundaries.

grammar_tips.title: Gerunds and Infinitives After Certain Verbs
grammar_tips.explanation: Some verbs are followed by '-ing' or 'to'. Example: I enjoy having downtime. I need to finish my work.

example_sentences.sentence: Work-life balance is important for good health.
You should make time for downtime each day.
Burnout happens when you overwork and don’t rest.
Remote work can make it harder to set boundaries.
